two_green_parallel_sum.scope: prime N >= 11; target Fourier matrix up to arbitrary row/column permutations and nonzero diagonal scalings
two_green_parallel_sum.statement: No F = A^{-1}+B^{-1} when A and B are invertible and each is supported on the diagonal plus one weighted permutation graph.
two_green_parallel_sum.covers: two independently ordered left/right diagonally gauged Green resolvents

two_stage_semiseparable.scope: prime N >= 31; invertible rank-one semiseparable stages; adjacent-nondegenerate relevant generator pairs; arbitrary internal and endpoint monomials
two_stage_semiseparable.statement: No monomially equivalent Fourier matrix equals S2 P S1.

next_gate: Three or more independently ordered Green terms with genuine joint evaluation, or inverse stages with more than one off-diagonal monomial graph and linear-time solve/application.
